provenance: AI interpretation linked to actual-collected sources; no human adjudication

sentence_family.interpretation: A resembles B through hyperbolic comparison; a reusable sentence family, not a topic-frequency label
sentence_family.discovery_origin: AI-selected phrase from initial name-free convenience-channel feed; later exact-phrase search is expansion

smurf_cat.interpretation: A blue cat-like character with a white cap and clothing recurs as a drawing and a three-dimensional craft figure
smurf_cat.discovery_origin: generic meme-topic query, then observed-name expansion

limitations: Text metadata only; images, audio, performance and conversational meaning are not examined.
Shared sentence fragments may be coincidences, copied captions, or ordinary titles.
This triage cannot establish meme prevalence, independent reuse, origin, accuracy or recall.
Every created relation is available at created_at, never backdated to the evidence cutoff.

limits: No popularity ranking or growth estimate
No controlled model understanding result or trained model weights
AI interpretation is not independent gold truth
All later links and interpretations become available now, not at the original feed cutoff
